1.explanation: • ComboBox/ComboBox.js: Implements the ComboBox; defines aria-owns and aria-controls attributes on the input and menu div. • ComboBox/index.js: Exports the component and sets up the example id namespace used in Storybook. • ComboBox/tools/generateId.js: Provides the logic for generating the “carbon-combobox-example__menu” id; crucial for understanding why the generated id doesn’t match any DOM node. • ListBox/index.js: Exports the underlying ListBox component used by ComboBox; it orchestrates menu rendering. • ListBox/ListBox.js: Renders the list container and wires up the ARIA props on the menu node. • ListBox/ListBoxMenu.js: Renders the actual menu items; attaches the id attribute and may reveal mismatches between id references and rendered elements. Together these files cover id generation, ARIA attribute wiring, and menu rendering—everything needed to reproduce and fix the invalid-id violations reported by DAP.
1.bug_scenario: The bug occurs in the React ComboBox examples when running the DAP accessibility checker in Storybook. In the screenshot, the ComboBox instance is rendered with a filter input (class “bx--text-input”) and a dropdown menu (a div with id “carbon-combobox-example__menu”) containing Option 1, Option 2, etc. DAP reports that the id specified for the WAI-ARIA properties aria-owns and aria-controls (“carbon-combobox-example__menu”) is not valid (the referenced element isn’t found or the id is malformed). Other violations (missing accessible name, missing ARIA landmark container) also surface. Key elements involved: the text input, the menu div and its generated id, the aria attributes on both input and div, and the list of options.
